correctness.rationale: For every non-codeword \(u\) in part \(V_i\), the proof derives \(I(C;u)=C\setminus C_i\); same-part omissions have equal identifying sets and distinct-part ordered differences equal the opposite part code set. These identities yield both structural classifications, including all singleton and one-omission boundary cases. Exhaustive direct definition checks over all 58 complete multipartite types of orders 2 through 8 match every claimed histogram and minimum.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge searches for both parameter names, spelling variants, complete-multipartite specializations, structural equivalents, and stronger coverage found the defining 2018 paper, the 2019 structural follow-up, and later location-code work, but no complete-multipartite classification, minimum-code count, or equivalent generating-function result.

value.rationale: The theorem determines two nontrivial domination-code parameters for every connected complete multipartite graph, classifies every valid code, counts all minimum codes, and gives full code-size generating functions. The partwise identifying-set identity is also reusable for related location-code questions.
